preconditions.description: The number of participants m and the number of top results n must satisfy the given constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= point <= 2 * m for point in points)
preconditions.description: All points in the input list must be non-negative and not exceed twice the number of participants.
The length of the points list must equal the number of top results n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'no' or (stdout.startswith('yes') and len(tournament) == m and all(len(row) == m for row in tournament))
postconditions.description: The output must be either 'no' or 'yes' followed by a valid tournament table if possible.

postconditions.expression: any(all(tournament[i][j] in 'XWDL' for j in range(m)) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each row in the tournament table must consist of valid characters 'X', 'W', 'D', and 'L'.

postconditions.expression: sorted([sum(2 if tournament[i][j] == 'W' else 1 if tournament[i][j] in 'DL' else 0 for j in range(m)) for i in range(m)], reverse=True)[:n] == points
postconditions.description: The sorted points of the top n participants must match the input points list.
